movement_profile.footwork: Measured walking steps in binary rhythm, with variations resembling pavane and galliard steps
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couples in procession or courtly line, moving forward or in place
movement_profile.partnering: Danced by couples, no complex partnering described

signature_moves.description: A possible figure involving a step plus a half-step, origin of the dance’s name
signature_moves.name: Step and a Half

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: No jumps or fast movements; maintain measured pace and grace

music_profile.musical_form: Repeated chord progression (ostinato bass) with melodic variations; often part of a suite
music_profile.sound_description: The passamezzo features a steady, repeating chord progression in minor (antico) or major (moderno) keys, played on lute or keyboard, with a calm and flowing rhythmic feel supporting measured dance steps.

basic_steps: Begin with a measured walking step in binary rhythm
Maintain upright posture with steady, graceful movement
Repeat step sequences in place or progressing forward
Incorporate variations resembling pavane steps and galliard movements
Conclude with a transition to a triple-time dance such as saltarello
teaching.formation: Couples dancing in procession or courtly line
teaching.level_notes: Technique not described in sources; teaching focuses on measured walking steps and rhythm awareness.

Human BDF consent/matching, moderation and measured session synchronization
Tested camera/split-screen delivery; AR remains an optional future adapter
